facts.text: The nearby stations disagree about this year: snow left Easy Pass (5,280 ft) 4 days earlier, Marten Ridge (3,520 ft) 24 days earlier and Wells Creek (4,040 ft) 26 days earlier than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Easy Pass
evidence.detail: left June 30; earlier seasons: June 27 (2023), July 8 (2024), July 4 (2025)

evidence.name: Marten Ridge
evidence.detail: left May 17; earlier seasons: June 12 (2023), June 8 (2024), June 10 (2025)

evidence.name: Wells Creek
evidence.detail: left May 11; earlier seasons: June 3 (2023), June 9 (2024), June 6 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Easy Pass (5,280 ft) and the lowest at Marten Ridge (3,520 ft) and Wells Creek (4,040 ft).

evidence.name: Easy Pass
evidence.detail: 95.0 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 89.3 in (2023), 71.0 in (2024), 87.4 in (2025)

evidence.name: Marten Ridge
evidence.detail: 23.2 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 59.8 in (2023), 32.0 in (2024), 46.2 in (2025)

evidence.name: Wells Creek
evidence.detail: 17.5 in on April 4; earlier seasons: 37.5 in (2023), 24.0 in (2024), 32.5 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 11 and July 16, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Easy Pass
evidence.detail: melted out June 30, 214 ft above the pass; points to June 3 to July 19

evidence.name: Marten Ridge
evidence.detail: melted out May 17, 1,546 ft below the pass; points to May 11 to July 16

evidence.name: Wells Creek
evidence.detail: melted out May 11, 1,026 ft below the pass; points to April 30 to June 27
